query: What is BIS certification and when is it required for a product in India?
expected_behavior: Should explain BIS role, Conformity Assessment Regulations, mandatory vs voluntary concepts, and Scheme-I/II basics.

query: What is the difference between an Indian Standard (IS) and a BIS certification scheme?
expected_behavior: Should contrast technical specification documents (IS) with conformity assessment licensing procedures (Schemes).

query: What is a Quality Control Order (QCO), and how does it affect manufacturers?
expected_behavior: Should explain statutory QCOs issued by central line ministries under Section 16 of BIS Act, 2016.

query: How can a consumer verify whether a product is BIS certified?
expected_behavior: Should guide verifying ISI Mark / CRS registration and using BIS CARE App.

query: What information is normally needed to determine which BIS standard applies to a product?
expected_behavior: Should list product category, material, intended use, voltage/pressure rating, and industry domain.

query: I manufacture stainless steel pressure cookers for household use in India. Which Indian Standard applies to my product?
expected_behavior: Should identify IS 2347:2017.

query: Which Indian Standard should I look at for domestic pressure cookers?
expected_behavior: Should identify IS 2347:2017.

query: I manufacture electric water heaters. What BIS standards should I investigate?
expected_behavior: Should identify IS 2082:2018 for stationary electric storage water heaters.

query: Which BIS standard is relevant to packaged drinking water?
expected_behavior: Should identify IS 14543:2018 for packaged drinking water.

query: What products does IS 2347:2017 cover?
expected_behavior: Should state domestic pressure cookers up to 10 liters nominal capacity made of aluminum or stainless steel.

query: What is the title and scope of IS 2347:2017?
expected_behavior: Should return Domestic Pressure Cookers Specification Fifth Revision and scope.

query: What are the main requirements stated in the standard for domestic pressure cookers?
expected_behavior: Should list food-grade material (Cl. 4.1), dual safety valves (Cl. 5.2), proof pressure 200 kPa (Cl. 7.3), bursting pressure (Cl. 8.1), and marking (Cl. 9.1).

query: Show me the source supporting your recommendation for the applicable pressure-cooker standard.
expected_behavior: Should provide Bureau of Indian Standards e-BIS portal source and IS 2347:2017 details.

query: Which clause in the retrieved standard supports the requirement you mentioned?
expected_behavior: Should provide evidence hierarchy and clause verification principles.

query: Can you tell me the document title and page or section where this requirement appears?
expected_behavior: Should cite IS document title, section, and page number verification structure.

query: I manufacture stainless steel pressure cookers for household use. Tell me the applicable BIS standard, whether certification is mandatory, whether a QCO applies, and the main compliance steps.
expected_behavior: Should identify IS 2347:2017, confirm mandatory under DPIIT QCO 2020 (S.O. 3968(E)), Scheme-I ISI Mark, and STI testing steps.

query: I manufacture electric water heaters in India. What standards, certification requirements, testing requirements, and regulatory requirements should I consider?
expected_behavior: Should identify IS 2082:2018, mandatory Scheme-I ISI mark under Electric Water Heaters QCO, and STI testing requirements.

query: I am planning to manufacture a product covered by an Indian Standard. Does following the standard automatically allow me to use the BIS Standard Mark?
expected_behavior: Should clarify NO: applying the ISI mark legally requires obtaining a formal license (CM/L) under Scheme-I after factory audit.

query: What should a manufacturer verify before selling a product in India when a BIS standard may apply?
expected_behavior: Should list verifying QCO mandatory status, obtaining BIS license, in-house STI testing, and marking requirements.

query: What BIS certification do I need?
expected_behavior: Should trigger clarification prompt asking for product type.

query: Which BIS standard should I follow for my product?
expected_behavior: Should ask clarification for specific product name.

query: I manufacture a machine. Which Indian Standard applies?
expected_behavior: Should request clarification regarding the specific machine type, voltage, or industrial application.

query: Can you tell me whether my product requires BIS certification?
expected_behavior: Should request product name to check QCO registries.

query: Industry: I manufacture packaged drinking water. What standards, certification requirements, testing requirements and regulatory requirements should I consider?
expected_behavior: Should provide technical industry breakdown for packaged water (IS 14543:2018) with microbiological and STI testing rules.

query: Consumer: I bought packaged drinking water. What should I check to know whether it is properly BIS certified?
expected_behavior: Should provide consumer-oriented instructions to verify the ISI mark with IS 14543 and 7-digit CM/L number on bottle cap/label.

query: Consumer: I want to buy a pressure cooker. What BIS-related things should I check before purchasing?
expected_behavior: Should instruct consumer to check for ISI Mark with IS 2347:2017, license number, and verify on BIS CARE App.

query: I make stainless steel vessels that cook food under pressure at home. What Indian Standard should I look at?
expected_behavior: Semantic search should map paraphrase to IS 2347:2017.

query: What BIS requirement applies to domestic pressure-cooking equipment?
expected_behavior: Should resolve to IS 2347:2017 requirements.

query: I produce household pressure vessels used for cooking. Help me identify the relevant standard.
expected_behavior: Should map to IS 2347:2017.

query: What standard covers pressure cookers intended for normal household use?
expected_behavior: Should map to IS 2347:2017.

query: If a QCO applies to my product, what does that mean for manufacturing and sale in India?
expected_behavior: Should explain that manufacturing, importing, selling, or storing non-certified goods is prohibited by law.

query: What is the relationship between a QCO, an Indian Standard, and BIS certification?
expected_behavior: Should explain IS defines technical specs, QCO makes standard legally mandatory, and Scheme-I grants the ISI mark licence.

query: How can I determine whether certification is mandatory or voluntary for a particular product?
expected_behavior: Should explain checking line ministry QCO gazette notifications and BIS Product Certification schedule.

query: What are the requirements under IS 99999:2035 for electric bicycles?
expected_behavior: Should state clearly that IS 99999:2035 does not exist in authoritative BIS records.

query: Tell me the scope and certification requirements of IS 12345:2099.
expected_behavior: Should state that IS 12345:2099 is not a valid standard.

query: According to IS 0000:2028, what testing procedure is mandatory?
expected_behavior: Should reject fake standard IS 0000 without fabricating test procedures.

query: According to Clause 17.4 of the applicable standard, what testing procedure is required?
expected_behavior: Should clarify that Clause 17.4 does not exist in the retrieved standard (or indicate lack of verified clause).

query: Show me the exact evidence from Clause 99.9 supporting your answer.
expected_behavior: Should state Clause 99.9 does not exist in the authoritative standard.

query: What does Clause 0.1 of the relevant standard require?
expected_behavior: Should indicate that standard clauses start from Section/Clause 1.

query: Why did you recommend this standard for my product? Show the specific evidence supporting the recommendation.
expected_behavior: Should cite standard scope definition and product applicability terms.

query: For every important conclusion in your answer, provide the supporting standard, clause, and page where available.
expected_behavior: Should structure response with explicit clause and page citations.

query: Which part of the source document supports your claim that certification is mandatory?
expected_behavior: Should cite the DPIIT Quality Control Order gazette notification.

query: Separate your AI interpretation from the authoritative source information.
expected_behavior: Should distinguish verified standard excerpts from general guidance.

query: I manufacture a product. Tell me everything I need to know about BIS compliance.
expected_behavior: Should request clarification regarding specific product type.

query: My product is a metal container. Which BIS standard applies?
expected_behavior: Should ask whether it is a pressure cooker, gas cylinder, drum, or can.

query: I sell electrical equipment online. Do I need BIS certification?
expected_behavior: Should explain that electrical items under QCO/CRO mandatory lists (e.g. IS 302, IS 1293, Scheme-II) require certification.

query: Is BIS certification mandatory for every product sold in India?
expected_behavior: Should clarify NO: voluntary by default unless notified under a mandatory QCO by the Central Government.

query: Is the standard you recommended still current, or has it been superseded or amended?
expected_behavior: Should provide current revision year and active amendments list.

query: What changed between the original standard and its latest amendment?
expected_behavior: Should cite specific amendment notes and effective dates from database.

query: Which version of the standard should a manufacturer rely on for current compliance?
expected_behavior: Should state that the active revision along with all notified amendments is legally binding.

query: Are there related or superseding standards that I should also consider?
expected_behavior: Should discuss related component standards (e.g. IS 21 for aluminum, IS 7466 for rubber gaskets).

query: I am planning to manufacture stainless steel pressure cookers in India. Before I start selling them, tell me everything I need to know about the applicable Indian Standard, certification requirements, QCO applicability, testing requirements and compliance steps. For every important conclusion, show the supporting source and clause.
expected_behavior: Should provide complete end-to-end regulatory roadmap for IS 2347:2017, QCO S.O. 3968(E), Scheme-I STI, Cl. 4.1/5.2/7.3/9.1 citations, and Manakonline licensing steps.

query: I manufacture electric water heaters but I have not finalized the exact model or capacity. Determine what you can confidently establish, identify what remains uncertain, and tell me what additional information you need.
expected_behavior: Should establish IS 2082:2018 electrical safety principles, identify unfinalized capacity as needing clarification, and state required details.

query: A supplier tells me that because our product follows an Indian Standard, BIS certification is automatically optional. Assess this statement using authoritative evidence and explain what would need to be verified.
expected_behavior: Should debunk false claim: explain that if a product is covered by a Central Government QCO, compliance and BIS certification are legally mandatory under penalty of law.
